fixture.contents: 70 tasks = 40 alias-OOD (30 orthogonal 3 families + 10 mixed header/body/query) + 12 exact + 12 no-applicable + 6 empty; registry per alias task = 3 mechanisms (train 0.9, distractor alias 0.9, low 0.8), intents held equal, hidden_expected.expected_template never in task registry (leak 0/40)

hierarchical.clustering: agglomerative average linkage, metric precomputed Jaccard distance (distance_threshold 0.4 i.e. component-set Jaccard >= 0.6), full component sets incl. url_segments
hierarchical.theme_scoring: unit-normalized TFIDF centroid cosine (TFIDF fit train-registry epochs only)
hierarchical.selection: adaptive k in [2,5], max 2 mechanisms per theme, expand while softmax entropy > 0.4 OR distinct component-type coverage < 2, min-k top-up, deterministic argmax ties
hierarchical.embeddings: sentence-transformers all-MiniLM-L6-v2, local CPU, normalize_embeddings=True, cached per unique string

execution_parameters.metrics: Wilson 95% CIs, one-sided binomial vs 0.10, paired McNemar, family-blocked bootstrap 2000 (fam0-3) for coverage/density gains and ECE, ECE 5 confidence bins, confidence std across tasks
